subject: MerchantLane — tiered benchmark & displacement offset offer
messages:
From: Alex Zhou <alex@merchantlane.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing — displacement ask and benchmark follow-up

Diego,

Thanks again for the benchmark run last week — the latency and throughput looked promising. We ran a shorter A/B against our OpenAI endpoints and the cost delta is the sticking point for our CFO (OpenAI blended net today is around $0.00024/token for our usage pattern after discounts).

MerchantLane is prepared to move off the incumbent if Redwood can:
- match or come within 10% of our blended per-token cost on a committed runway, OR
- provide a structured, measurable offset (credits + discounts) during a 90-day displacement pilot that demonstrates 12%+ TCO improvement over current, including egress and peering costs.

We expect an initial 3‑month ramp to 120M tokens/month, then 12 months averaging ~180M tokens/month if performance holds. Important constraints for procurement:
- Single PO (no multiple vendor invoices)
- SOC 2 / audit artifacts in the contract appendix
- Clear rollback/fallback plan in case of quality regressions

Can you send a concrete per-token proposal (+ any special onboarding credits) and a simple mutual action plan (dates/milestones) by EOD tomorrow? I'll loop in finance/procurement after that.

- Alex
Head of AI Engineering
MerchantLane

P.S. attaching the short evaluation log from our side (samples + perf traces).

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Zhou <alex@merchantlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 12:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing — displacement ask and benchmark follow-up

Alex — really appreciate the detailed notes and the evaluation traces, that made the benchmarking fast. High level response and an offer below; attaching our pricing grid and a starter forecast to align on bands.

Quick summary (proposal):
- Pilot: 90-day displacement pilot, up to 120M tokens/month. Redwood provides a $50k onboarding credit and waived peering setup fee.
- Commit ramp / Pricing (12-month term, monthly billing, blended tiers):
  • Tier A (0–50M): $0.00036/token
  • Tier B (50–200M): $0.00029/token
  • Tier C (200M+): $0.00024/token
- Blended target: based on your forecast we can push to a $0.00027/token blended rate at 180M/mo if you sign a 12‑month commit with quarterly reporting.
- SLA & operational: 99.9% inference availability, guaranteed regional routing (us-west) and dedicated priority queue during pilot. Rollback: automatic fallback to your existing endpoints on error rates above threshold for two consecutive hours.
- Compliance: we’ll include SOC 2 Type II artifact references and a security appendix; Marissa will handle evidence handoff.

Next steps / MAP (mutual action plan):
1) You confirm pilot start window (we proposed Jan 4 in the attached sheet).
2) Redwood sends SOW + pricing attachment and a PO-ready invoice.
3) Pilot onboarding (3–5 business days), run, and weekly checkpoints.
4) Post-pilot: finalize 12‑month commit and billing cadence.

We attached: Redwood-pricing-grid-v4.pdf (details on quantization/latency tiers) and a starter ML-forecast-Q4.xlsx we filled based on the numbers you shared.

If you need a sharper one-time discount to bridge to OpenAI parity during the pilot, we can do a temporary blended floor of $0.00025/token for months 1–2 of the pilot (subject to legal approval). Ben/Marissa — can you confirm if finance/legal are OK with the temporary floor and whether we should route the PO via our enterprise billing flow?

Happy to jump on a quick call with procurement this afternoon if that helps.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Revenue — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: Redwood-pricing-grid-v4.pdf; ML-forecast-Q4.xlsx

From: Alex Zhou <alex@merchantlane.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@merchantlane.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing — displacement ask and benchmark follow-up

Diego — thanks for the quick, concrete proposal. A few clarifications and asks from procurement: 

1) The temporary floor of $0.00025/token for months 1–2 is close, but procurement is asking whether Redwood can extend a bridge to match our incumbent blended at $0.00024 for month 1 only if we sign the pilot SOW by Dec 20. That would remove the immediate blocker for our CFO.

2) Please include SOC 2 evidence + a redacted network diagram in the SOW appendix.

3) DocuSign: we need a PO-ready invoice and an executed SOW with a mutual SLA (we prefer monthly invoicing).

Quoted for context: 
On Tue, Dec 8, 2026 at 12:35 PM, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Alex — really appreciate the detailed notes and the evaluation traces, that made the benchmarking fast. High level response and an offer below; attaching our pricing grid and a starter forecast to align on bands.
>
> Quick summary (proposal):
> - Pilot: 90-day displacement pilot, up to 120M tokens/month. Redwood provides a $50k onboarding credit and waived peering setup fee.
> - Commit ramp / Pricing (12-month term, monthly billing, blended tiers):
>   • Tier A (0–50M): $0.00036/token
>   • Tier B (50–200M): $0.00029/token
>   • Tier C (200M+): $0.00024/token
> - Blended target: based on your forecast we can push to a $0.00027/token blended rate at 180M/mo if you sign a 12‑month commit with quarterly reporting.
>
We can sign to the Dec 20 SOW deadline if Redwood confirms the month-1 parity of $0.00024 and sends the DocuSign PO-ready doc. We’ll also want the rollback mechanics codified so procurement can sign without legal memos.

If you can get that in writing today, I’ll route it to finance for final approval.

— Alex
Head of AI Engineering, MerchantLane

Attachment: merchantlane-eval-log.txt

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MerchantLane — tiered benchmark & displacement offset offer — next steps

Ben/Marissa — quick internal note and proposed play:

1) MerchantLane asked for month-1 parity at $0.00024 if we can get the SOW in by Dec 20. They will start finance routing immediately upon receipt.
2) We already committed a $50k onboarding credit and a temporary floor of $0.00025 for months 1–2; Alex wants the extra 1 cent (0.00001) bridge for month 1 only.
3) Proposed internal approvals:
   • Finance: approve one-time one-cent-per-token concession for month 1 and allow PO on enterprise billing flow.
   • Legal: prepare SOW with SOC 2 appendix and a clear rollback clause (fallback after 2-hour sustained error window).
   • Ops: be ready for a Jan 4 start; engineering to reserve priority queue in us-west for the pilot.

Marissa — can you drop the SOC2 artifact bundle and the pricing grid to Alex once legal OKs the SOW text? Ben — can you confirm if finance will accept the one-time month-1 parity concession and whether we should take it against reserve credits or as an explicit rebate line item?

If we can sign Dec 20 we’ll likely win displacement given their ramp profile.

Thanks — Diego
Director, Revenue — Redwood Inference
